nd062ed36df.why: Air Mozambique is the state-owned national carrier, and governance problems at state enterprises can affect public finances and investor confidence.

nb80f402bcb.headline: Search for accountability begins after massive data breach in Latvia – CSDD chief points to Tet
nb80f402bcb.summary: The head of Latvia's road traffic safety directorate CSDD points to Tet, which was responsible for monitoring the agency's IT infrastructure. Tet failed to detect the cyberattack, according to the report.
nb80f402bcb.why: Data breaches at public agencies raise cybersecurity costs and liability for IT service providers.

n6f238656f0.headline: Thailand Drivers Face Pain as Gas and Diesel Prices Jump
n6f238656f0.summary: Gasoline and diesel prices in Thailand rose by 0.85 baht per litre this week, adding to drivers' costs. The Chiang Rai Times report did not give the cause of the increase.
n6f238656f0.why: Fuel prices feed into transport costs, consumer spending and inflation in Thailand.

ndfab3ecf59.headline: UAE denies providing financial facilities to Iran after suspending trade
ndfab3ecf59.summary: The UAE denied providing financial facilities to Iran, hours after announcing it would suspend trade and financial exchanges with Tehran until further notice.
ndfab3ecf59.why: The UAE is a major regional trade and financial hub, so restrictions on trade and banking with Iran affect cross-border payments and commodity flows.

n6958d6b86c.headline: DMV LOCAL RECAP: Food Prices Could Face More Pressure in 2027
n6958d6b86c.summary: Grocery bills could face more pressure as El Niño, fertilizer disruptions and food safety concerns put the global food supply in focus. The outlook points to higher food costs in 2027.
n6958d6b86c.why: El Niño weather patterns and fertilizer supply shape crop yields and global food commodity prices.

nd017101719.headline: Mizrahi Tefahot Bank Shares Close Lower, Likely Weighed By Q2 Profit Decline
nd017101719.summary: Mizrahi Tefahot Bank shares closed at 23,220 shekels, down 10 shekels, after the bank reported a decline in second-quarter net profit. The results were announced recently.
nd017101719.why: Mizrahi Tefahot is one of Israel's major listed banks, so its quarterly results are watched as a read on the country's banking sector.

nfa6dbb94cb.headline: Labor Rules out Raising Compulsory Super Contribution From 12 to 15 Percent
nfa6dbb94cb.summary: Labor has ruled out lifting the compulsory superannuation contribution from 12 to 15 percent. It also plans to stop unsolicited sales calls urging switches to high-risk investments.
nfa6dbb94cb.why: Superannuation is Australia's compulsory retirement savings system, and contribution rates affect pension assets and fund flows.

n28dcca4770.headline: Iran weighs strikes on US military targets in Europe if war escalates: Report
n28dcca4770.summary: Iran has considered striking US military assets in Europe if US President Donald Trump escalates the war, according to a Financial Times report.
n28dcca4770.why: Attacks beyond the Middle East would widen the geopolitical risk premium priced into energy and defence markets.

nf775b703eb.headline: Thai industrial sentiment rises for a second straight month in July
nf775b703eb.summary: Thailand's industrial sentiment index rose for a second straight month in July, due to strong electric vehicle sales and government support measures, the Federation of Thai Industries reported.
nf775b703eb.why: The Federation of Thai Industries' sentiment index is a leading gauge of manufacturing confidence, and Thailand is a major regional auto and EV production hub.

n18dc009d86.headline: Donald Trump says no Iran talks planned, shares map showing Hormuz as 'new US territory'
n18dc009d86.summary: Iran said it will not reopen the waterway until the US halts its blockade of Iranian ports. President Trump said no talks are planned.
n18dc009d86.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a major oil transit route, so closure or reopening decisions affect global energy prices.
n18dc009d86.why_moved: Conflicting signals on talks and the strait's status keep oil supply uncertainty elevated.

n3aff630a21.headline: Iraq, Iran Discuss Cooperation in Banking | Iraq Business News
n3aff630a21.summary: The governors of the central banks of Iraq and Iran met in Baghdad to discuss financial and banking cooperation between the two countries. Iran's ambassador also attended.
n3aff630a21.why: Central bank cooperation affects cross-border payments and banking links, which matter for trade and sanctions compliance in the region.

n6706ec31c7.headline: ‘All trade, commercial exchanges halted’: How UAE responded to Iran’s latest ballistic missile attack
n6706ec31c7.summary: The United Arab Emirates suspended all trade, commercial exchanges and financial transactions with Iran after accusing Tehran of launching two ballistic missiles toward the Gulf state.
n6706ec31c7.why: The UAE is a major Gulf trade and finance hub, so halting dealings with Iran affects regional trade flows and banking channels.

n9524064ca7.headline: Click, click, boom: AI mania and war trigger rate fears
n9524064ca7.summary: Insatiable demand for computing power has pushed up technology product prices, driving up imported inflation in Australia. The article links these price pressures to rate fears.
n9524064ca7.why: Imported inflation affects the Reserve Bank of Australia's interest rate decisions, which shape borrowing costs and asset valuations.

n48545768aa.headline: The UK pension pot question: Why 2026-27 is the year to decide
n48545768aa.summary: From April 2027, UK pension pots will be subject to inheritance tax, prompting a reassessment of legacy planning. Indian holders of UK pensions are weighing transfers to QROPS before the deadline.
n48545768aa.why: Changes to inheritance tax on pensions alter the estate planning and tax liabilities of UK pension savers, and the rules are set by HM Revenue and Customs and UK government policy.

n9ecc656e92.headline: Pakistan’s Retailer App: How the new digital tax scheme could change small businesses
n9ecc656e92.summary: Pakistan's government is rolling out the Retailer App to broaden the tax base and make it easier for shopkeepers to comply. The scheme is intended to affect small businesses.
n9ecc656e92.why: Expanding the tax base brings small informal retailers into the formal economy, which affects government revenue and compliance costs for small firms.

n36b4c42a00.headline: Saudis Offer To Sell Oil Near Oman, A Sign They're Sailing Dark Through Hormuz
n36b4c42a00.summary: Saudi Arabia has begun sending oil tankers back through the Strait of Hormuz after weeks of routing around it, and is offering crude for sale near Oman.
n36b4c42a00.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne oil, so shipping changes there feed directly into crude prices and freight costs.
n36b4c42a00.why_moved: Saudi tankers are resuming transit through Hormuz and crude is being offered near Oman, signalling more oil reaching markets via the strait.

nc7958cc557.headline: Why has inflation shot up and where will it go from here?
nc7958cc557.summary: Experts are predicting further inflation pain later this year, caused by the ongoing Middle East conflict. The outlook was presented as a key concern for households.
nc7958cc557.why: Inflation trends guide central bank interest rate decisions, which affect bond yields and borrowing costs.

n5298b9973a.headline: 15-year sales tax exemption on imports approved for PIA, other airlines
n5298b9973a.summary: The National Assembly Standing Committee on Privatization approved a proposal to exempt airlines from sales tax on imported goods for 15 years. The measure covers PIA and other carriers.
n5298b9973a.why: Pakistan International Airlines is the national carrier, and tax exemptions affect airline costs and their privatisation prospects.

nc38e5a5938.headline: Inflation increases to 2.9% in July
nc38e5a5938.summary: The UK's inflation rate rose to 2.9% in July, according to the latest Office for National Statistics data.
nc38e5a5938.why: Inflation drives Bank of England interest-rate decisions, which shape gilt yields, sterling and borrowing costs for UK companies and households.

neeccc3bc7e.headline: Stocks flat with quiet action elsewhere; USD moves lower into FOMC minutes - Newsquawk US Market Open
neeccc3bc7e.summary: US stocks were flat in quiet trade and the dollar moved lower ahead of the FOMC minutes, according to Newsquawk. Politico reported that Trump is waiting for Iran to yield to economic pressure.
neeccc3bc7e.why: The S&P 500 tracks large US companies, and the FOMC minutes give detail on Federal Reserve policy deliberations that shape interest rate expectations.

n6a04bb8298.headline: بعد تصريحات ترمب.. إيران تؤكد إغلاق باب التفاوض مع أمريكا
n6a04bb8298.summary: An Iranian source said no negotiations exist between Iran and the United States, after Trump confirmed the door to talks with Tehran had closed. He said no talks were under way or expected.
n6a04bb8298.why: Iran's oil exports and the Strait of Hormuz shipping route are central to global energy supply, so the status of US-Iran diplomacy shapes geopolitical risk for investors.

n60b4a87f23.headline: Iran weighs strikes on US military targets in Europe if war escalates: Financial Times
n60b4a87f23.summary: The Financial Times reported that Iranian forces assessed potential targets in southeastern Europe in case the war escalates. The report is based on the FT's own claims.
n60b4a87f23.why: Escalation risk involving NATO-linked territory raises geopolitical risk premiums across European and global markets.

ne81178d13d.headline: Jeff Currie: Forget $91 Brent, The Real Crisis Is $170 Diesel
ne81178d13d.summary: Jeff Currie told CNBC that refineries consume crude while consumers use gasoline, diesel and jet fuel. He argued those product markets look considerably uglier than crude.
ne81178d13d.why: Refined product prices such as diesel and jet fuel feed directly into transport, freight and inflation costs.

ndc433f15c3.headline: Bangladesh Seeks Faster India Business Visas,
ndc433f15c3.summary: Bangladesh urged India to speed up business visa issuance and remove trade barriers. Dhaka also sought a guarantee clause in the renewed Ganges Water Treaty.
ndc433f15c3.why: India and Bangladesh are major trading partners, and visa and tariff rules affect cross-border trade and investment.

n0a83acb84e.headline: Iran announces near-total halt in oil supplies to foreign markets
n0a83acb84e.summary: Iran has almost completely halted oil supplies to foreign markets, according to central bank governor Abdolnasser Hemmati, as reported by APA citing Mehr News Agency.
n0a83acb84e.why: Iran is a major oil producer, and a halt in its exports removes significant crude from global markets, affecting benchmark prices.
n0a83acb84e.why_moved: Iran has almost completely halted oil supplies to foreign markets, removing a significant volume of crude from global supply.

n5398e439fc.headline: Genting Plantations expects palm oil prices to stay supported
n5398e439fc.summary: Genting Plantations expects palm oil prices to remain supported near term, citing higher biofuel blending mandates in major producing countries and firmer energy prices.
n5398e439fc.why: Palm oil is a major edible oil and biofuel feedstock, so its prices affect food, energy and plantation company earnings.

ndcd3951be8.headline: Baghdad approves new crude export outlets | The Jerusalem Post
ndcd3951be8.summary: Baghdad approved new crude export outlets as Iraq seeks to diversify its oil export channels amid the Iran war and the closure of the Strait of Hormuz.
ndcd3951be8.why: Iraq is a major oil exporter, and alternative export routes help maintain supply when the Strait of Hormuz is disrupted.

n78d1405e7d.headline: موجة بيع لـ«التكنولوجيا» تكبد أسهم اليابان خسائر حادة
n78d1405e7d.summary: Japanese stocks fell sharply, with the Nikkei recording its largest decline in three weeks after a broad selloff in US technology shares. Concerns over the Middle East and higher US Treasury yields also weighed.
n78d1405e7d.why: The Nikkei 225 is Japan's benchmark equity index, heavily weighted toward export and technology companies, so it tracks global tech and risk sentiment closely.
n78d1405e7d.why_moved: The index fell after a broad selloff in US technology stocks the prior session. Geopolitical worries in the Middle East and rising US bond yields added pressure.

n02489d5210.headline: Gold Price drops by Rs3,700 per tola in Pakistan
n02489d5210.summary: Gold per tola in Pakistan dropped to Rs458,236, down Rs3,700 from the previous level in local markets.
n02489d5210.why: Local gold prices track international bullion prices and the rupee exchange rate.

n5a13d70de1.headline: EBOS Group FY26 Results Rise, Sees Higher FY27 Underlying EBITDA; Stock Up - Update
n5a13d70de1.summary: EBOS Group reported higher fiscal 2026 results and maintained its dividend. The healthcare and animal care products provider also expects higher underlying EBITDA in fiscal 2027.
n5a13d70de1.why: EBOS is an Australasian distributor of healthcare and animal care products. Its results and earnings guidance indicate the health of its distribution business.

nc26cd9b13d.summary: New Zealand's NZX 50 was among the stronger Asian performers for a second day. Investors reacted to results from Ebos Group and Fletcher Building, which kept the benchmark positive.

n682a65bde7.headline: Surging energy prices push inflation up to highest level since March
n682a65bde7.summary: The Office for National Statistics said CPI inflation rose to 2.9 in July from 2.6 in June, a 15-month low. Surging energy prices were cited as the driver.
n682a65bde7.why: Consumer price inflation drives Bank of England rate expectations, which affect gilt yields, sterling and UK equity valuations.

nd9839f332b.headline: Iran's mullahs 'are considering attacks on European military targets'
nd9839f332b.summary: A report says Iran is considering attacks on US military targets in Europe if Donald Trump escalates the war. The report describes Tehran's options, not confirmed action.
nd9839f332b.why: Escalation involving Iran affects oil supply risk and global risk sentiment across markets.

n004be9d3f7.headline: UAE halts all trade, financial dealings with Iran - World News
n004be9d3f7.summary: The United Arab Emirates suspended all trade with Iran on Aug. 19 after it said it came under renewed fire from the country. The move further isolates Iran, which faces US sanctions and a blockade.
n004be9d3f7.why: The UAE is a major Gulf trade and finance hub, so trade restrictions with Iran affect regional shipping, banking and commodity flows.
n004be9d3f7.why_moved: The UAE said it came under renewed fire from Iran, and it suspended all trade and financial dealings in response, adding to US sanctions and a blockade on Iran.

n59bf9eac38.headline: Piyush Goyal visits Singapore with 70-member business delegation to deepen economic ties
n59bf9eac38.summary: India's Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal is visiting Singapore from August 19 to 21 with a 70-member business delegation for the fourth India-Singapore Ministerial Roundtable.
n59bf9eac38.why: Singapore is a major Southeast Asian trade and financial hub, and India-Singapore ties cover trade, investment and services.

ne54d00bbb0.headline: SC asks Centre to respond to PIL seeking MSP for all notified crops based on Swaminathan panel formula
ne54d00bbb0.summary: The Supreme Court asked the Centre to respond to a public interest petition seeking a legally enforceable minimum support price for all notified crops. The plea cites the Swaminathan panel formula.
ne54d00bbb0.why: Minimum support prices set the floor for government purchases of crops and shape farm incomes and food-market costs in India.

n125c79ea1c.headline: CARsgen Reports H1 Interim Results; Expands CAR-T Pipeline
n125c79ea1c.summary: CARsgen Therapeutics, a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company listed in Hong Kong, announced its 2026 interim half-year results on Wednesday. It also provided several clinical updates.
n125c79ea1c.why: CARsgen develops cell therapies, including CAR-T treatments for cancer. Clinical progress and pipeline expansion drive valuations for early-stage biotech companies.

n35ce17e065.headline: AI in Indian banking: Why technology may reshape jobs, not replace bankers
n35ce17e065.summary: Indian banks are entering an AI-driven transition, with private banks cutting headcount while public sector hiring offsets some losses. Strong credit growth and low household debt could limit near-term job displacement.
n35ce17e065.why: India's banking sector is a major part of its economy, and changes in staffing and technology affect bank costs and credit delivery.

ncb4eaf03d1.headline: [INTERVIEW] Korean food exports face tough battle in Vietnam
ncb4eaf03d1.summary: Korean food products have drawn global attention, with labels such as Buldak sparking a rare consumer frenzy, but exporters face a tough battle in Vietnam, according to an interview.
ncb4eaf03d1.why: Vietnam is a fast-growing consumer market in Southeast Asia, and food exporters depend on local competition and consumer demand there.

n216511a8e7.headline: Tencent Music (TME) Turns Streaming Into A Sprawling Entertainment Machine
n216511a8e7.summary: Tencent Music reported total second-quarter 2026 revenue of RMB 8.9 billion, up 6% year on year. The newly consolidated Ximalaya platform contributed about RMB 0.4 billion of that total.
n216511a8e7.why: Tencent Music Entertainment is China's leading online music streaming company, listed in New York, so its results indicate demand for digital audio and entertainment services.

n9298b3bc58.headline: SKK Holdings Stock Rises 14% After Securing Six New Singapore Contracts
n9298b3bc58.summary: SKK Holdings shares rose $0.65, or 14.25%, to $5.21 on Wednesday. The company announced six new contracts for horizontal directional drilling and utility works in Singapore.
n9298b3bc58.why: SKK Holdings is a small-cap company, so new contract announcements can have a significant effect on its share price and revenue outlook.

nbf531cb593.headline: [EXPLAINER] Why Yongsan Park is Seoul's newest housing battleground
nbf531cb593.summary: The government is considering using Yongsan Park, a proposed green space on a former U.S. military garrison, as a site for new housing construction.
nbf531cb593.why: Housing supply decisions in Seoul affect property prices, which are a major policy focus in South Korea.

nac8267c4f5.headline: CARsgen Therapeutics Announces 2026 Interim Results
nac8267c4f5.summary: CARsgen Therapeutics reported 2026 interim results, with cash and cash equivalents of around RMB1,400 million as of June 30, 2026.
nac8267c4f5.why: CARsgen is a Hong Kong-listed biotech developing CAR T-cell cancer therapies, so its cash position and results matter to investors in its shares.

n7c654abd47.headline: Ranil Warns Sri Lanka Faces Fresh Bankruptcy Risk by End of 2028
n7c654abd47.summary: Former President Ranil Wickremesinghe warned that Sri Lanka could once again be pushed to the brink of economic collapse by the end of 2028. The article does not give further detail in the excerpt.
n7c654abd47.why: Sri Lanka defaulted on its external debt in 2022, so warnings about renewed debt stress are closely watched by bond investors.

n45379e52e9.headline: Creditors see 1% recovery in case of personal guarantees
n45379e52e9.summary: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code proceedings recovered around 31% of corporate claims, but creditors recovered only about 1% of amounts offered as personal guarantees.
n45379e52e9.why: India's Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code governs corporate debt resolution, and recovery rates affect how lenders price and secure credit.

n8b16193123.headline: Shiprocket shares jump 35 pc in market debut trade
